'''January 2001 Minneapolis tournament (16 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 16 January 2001. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1639">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-17-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-16d1639/ moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-16], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 17 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-17-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-16d1639/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
